mainEntity.name: Who is the Moonwalk Speaker Method for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Managers, directors and executives who present often, and aspiring speakers building their first stage talk.

mainEntity.name: How long does the programme take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twelve weeks, with one 75 minute session a week and short practice between sessions.
Yes. Most clients work with us on video, and we review recordings of real meetings and talks.

mainEntity.name: What happens in the Voice Audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: A free 30 minute call where you speak for two minutes, and we tell you the three habits holding your presence back. No obligation.
